item.title: Is Netanyahu exporting Gaza’s crisis to the Horn of Africa?
item.description: On 26 December 2025, Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is presenting the decision as a diplomatic breakthrough, an extension of the Abraham Accords logic into the Horn of Africa.
